disagrees\n+    with the booleans. Missing, malformed, inconsistent or uncertain results are\n+    UNKNOWN (which continues the debate) — never NO_PROGRESS.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+\n+    outcome = payload.get(\"outcome\")\n+    if outcome == UNKNOWN:\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+\n+    bull = payload.get(\"bull\")\n+    bear = payload.get(\"bear\")\n+    if not isinstance(bull, dict) or not isinstance(bear, dict):\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+    for side in (bull, bear):\n+        if not all(isinstance(side.get(k), bool) for k in (\"new_evidence\", \"first_reply\")):\n+            return UNKNOWN\n+        if side.get(\"confidence\") not in _CONFIDENCE_RANK:\n+            return UNKNOWN\n+\n+    progress = _flags_any_true(bull) or _flags_any_true(bear)\n+    no_progress = not progress\n+\n+    # Inconsistent: the stated outcome contradicts the booleans.\n+    if outcome == PROGRESS and no_progress:\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+    if outcome == NO_PROGRESS and progress:\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+\n+    if progress:\n+        return PROGRESS\n+\n+    # A weak negative on either side must not become a confirmed NO_PROGRESS.\n+    if any(_CONFIDENCE_RANK[side[\"confidence\"]] < _CONFIDENCE_RANK[\"medium\"]\n+           for side in (bull, bear)):\n+        return UNKNOWN\n+\n+    # Confirmed repetition: all flags false, both sides medium+, outcome agrees.\n+    return NO_PROGRESS\n+\n+\n+class DebateJudge:\n+    \"\"\"Invokes the quick-tier model for a structured judgement.\"\"\"\n+\n+    def __init__(self, llm):\n+        try:\n+            self._structured = llm.with_structured_output(DebateJudgement)\n+        except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError):\n+            self._structured = None\n+\n+    def invoke(self, prompt) -> ProgressResult:\n+        \"\"\"Return a ProgressResult with the mapped outcome.\n+\n+        A structural failure yields UNKNOWN. The round is tagged by the caller\n+        (the bear node), so it is left at 0 here.\n+        \"\"\"\n+        if self._structured is None:\n+            return ProgressResult(UNKNOWN, 0)\n+        payload = self._structured.invoke(prompt)\n+        return ProgressResult(classify_judgement(_payload_to_dict(payload)), 0)\n+\n+\n+def build_debate_judge(llm) -> DebateJudge:\n+    \"\"\"Build the judge from the existing quick-tier LLM (no new client).\"\"\"\n+    return DebateJudge(llm)\n+\n+\n+def evaluate_pair(judge, history: str, bull_turn: str, bear_turn: str,\n+                  round_number: int) -> ProgressResult:\n+    \"\"\"Run the judge for one completed pair and tag it with the round.\n+\n+    A failed or malformed judgement becomes UNKNOWN (continue); it is never\n+    retried as free text. Provider/SDK-level transport retries inside the client\n+    are not judgement attempts.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    prompt = _render_prompt(history, bull_turn, bear_turn)\n+    try:\n+        result = judge.invoke(prompt)\n+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — a broken judge must not end the run\n+        logger.warning(\"Debate progress judgement failed: %s\", exc)\n+        return ProgressResult(UNKNOWN, round_number)\n+\n+    outcome = getattr(result, \"outcome\", None)\n+    if outcome not in (PROGRESS, NO_PROGRESS, UNKNOWN):\n+        outcome = UNKNOWN\n+    return ProgressResult(outcome, round_number)\n+\n+\n+def _payload_to_dict(payload) -> dict | None:\n+    if payload is None:\n+        return None\n+    if isinstance(payload, dict):\n+        return payload\n+    model_dump = getattr(payload, \"model_dump\", None)\n+    if callable(model_dump):\n+        return model_dump()\n+    return None\n+\n+\n+def _render_prompt(history: str, bull_turn: str, bear_turn: str) -> str:\n+    return f\"\"\"You judge progress in a bull-versus-bear investment debate. One round is one bull turn and one bear turn.\n+\n+Decide, for each side, whether that side's turn:\n+- introduced evidence NEW to this debate (a fact or observation not already present in the history), judged by meaning — a reused number that carries a different fact still counts as new; a qualitative claim with no number can be new; a fact restated with only new citation labels is not new; and\n+- gave a FIRST substantive response to a specific opposing argument that had NO prior substantive response in this history — a reply that merely repeats a rebuttal already made and answered is not a first reply.\n+\n+Judge only against the history given. A reply is a \"first reply\" only if the opposing point it answers was previously unanswered in THIS history.\n+\n+Prior debate history:\n+{history}\n+\n+Current bull turn:\n+{bull_turn}\n+\n+Current bear turn (judge it against the history plus the current bull turn):\n+{bear_turn}\n+\n+Return for each side a boolean new_evidence, a boolean first_reply and a confidence of low, medium or high. max_debate_rounds turns each for bull and bear\n-            return \"Research Manager\"\n-        if state[\"investment_debate_state\"][\"current_response\"].startswith(\"Bull\"):\n-            return \"Bear Researcher\"\n-        return \"Bull Researcher\"\n-\n-    def should_continue_risk_analysis(self, state: AgentState) -> str:\n-        \"\"\"Determine if risk analysis should continue.\"\"\"\n-        if (\n-            state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"count\"] >= 3 * self.max_risk_discuss_rounds\n-        ):  # max_risk_discuss_rounds turns each for the three risk analysts\n-            return \"Portfolio Manager\"\n-        if state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"latest_speaker\"].startswith(\"Aggressive\"):\n-            return \"Conservative Analyst\"\n-        if state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"latest_speaker\"].startswith(\"Conservative\"):\n-            return \"Neutral Analyst\"\n-        return \"Aggressive Analyst\"\n+from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import NO_PROGRESS\r\n+from tradingagents.agents.state import AgentState\r\n+\r\n+\r\n+class ConditionalLogic:\r\n+    \"\"\"Handles conditional logic for determining graph flow.\"\"\"\r\n+\r\n+    def __init__(self, max_debate_rounds=1, max_risk_discuss_rounds=1):\r\n+        \"\"\"Initialize with configuration parameters.\"\"\"\r\n+        self.max_debate_rounds = max_debate_rounds\r\n+        self.max_risk_discuss_rounds = max_risk_discuss_rounds\r\n+\r\n+    def should_continue_debate(self, state: AgentState) -> str:\r\n+        \"\"\"Determine if debate should continue.\r\n+\r\n+        The round cap is checked first and always wins. The opening round always\r\n+        lets both researchers speak. From round two, a completed pair whose\r\n+        persisted judgement (written by the bear node) is NO_PROGRESS for this\r\n+        round ends the debate; the router never re-judges.\r\n+        \"\"\"\r\n+        debate = state[\"investment_debate_state\"]\r\n+        count = debate[\"count\"]\r\n+\r\n+        # Cap takes priority over any progress verdict.\r\n+        if count >= 2 * self.max_debate_rounds:\r\n+            return \"Research Manager\"\r\n+\r\n+        bull_spoke = debate.get(\"current_response\", \"\").startswith(\"Bull\")\r\n+\r\n+        # An incomplete round gives the other side its turn (order preserved).\r\n+        if count % 2 != 0:\r\n+            return \"Bear Researcher\" if bull_spoke else \"Bull Researcher\"\r\n+        if bull_spoke:\r\n+            return \"Bear Researcher\"\r\n+\r\n+        # Completed pair: stop only on a confirmed NO_PROGRESS for this round.\r\n+        if (\r\n+            debate.get(\"progress_outcome\") == NO_PROGRESS\r\n+            and debate.get(\"progress_round\") == count // 2\r\n+        ):\r\n+            return \"Research Manager\"\r\n+\r\n+        return \"Bull Researcher\"\r\n+\r\n+    def should_continue_risk_analysis(self, state: AgentState) -> str:\r\n+        \"\"\"Determine if risk analysis should continue.\"\"\"\r\n+        if (\r\n+            state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"count\"] >= 3 * self.max_risk_discuss_rounds\r\n+        ):  # max_risk_discuss_rounds turns each for the three risk analysts\r\n+            return \"Portfolio Manager\"\r\n+        if state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"latest_speaker\"].startswith(\"Aggressive\"):\r\n+            return \"Conservative Analyst\"\r\n+        if state[\"risk_debate_state\"][\"latest_speaker\"].startswith(\"Conservative\"):\r\n+            return \"Neutral Analyst\"\r\n+        return \"Aggressive Analyst\"\r\n",

Each edge driven by the\r\n+# router maps all of them, so a fall-through return (e.g. under prompt/i18n/\r\n+# refactor drift in the speaker labels) can never hit a missing path_map entry\r\n+# and crash LangGraph mid-run (#1088).\r\n+DEBATE_PATH_MAP = {\r\n+    \"Bull Researcher\": \"Bull Researcher\",\r\n+    \"Bear Researcher\": \"Bear Researcher\",\r\n+    \"Research Manager\": \"Research Manager\",\r\n+}\r\n+RISK_ANALYSIS_PATH_MAP = {\r\n+    \"Aggressive Analyst\": \"Aggressive Analyst\",\r\n+    \"Conservative Analyst\": \"Conservative Analyst\",\r\n+    \"Neutral Analyst\": \"Neutral Analyst\",\r\n+    \"Portfolio Manager\": \"Portfolio Manager\",\r\n+}\r\n+\r\n+\r\n+def _tools_or_done(state) -> str:\r\n+    \"\"\"Route an analyst's turn: run its tool calls, or finish with its report.\"\"\"\r\n+    return \"tools\" if state[\"messages\"][-1].tool_calls else END\r\n+\r\n+\r\n+def _analyst_graph(spec, agent, max_tool_rounds: int):\r\n+    \"\"\"One analyst as a graph of its own: the model and its tools, on a private message history.\r\n+\r\n+    It returns only its report, so analysts running side by side never write the\r\n+    same key, and its tool calls never reach the other analysts' messages. After\r\n+    ``max_tool_rounds`` rounds of tool calls it is told to write its report, and\r\n+    that turn ends it whatever it answers, so a model that keeps calling tools\r\n+    cannot run the graph into its recursion limit (#1420).\r\n+    \"\"\"\r\n+    output = TypedDict(f\"{spec.key.capitalize()}Report\", {spec.report_key: str})\r\n+    graph = StateGraph(AgentState, output_schema=output)\r\n+    graph.add_node(\"agent\", agent)\r\n+    graph.add_edge(START, \"agent\")\r\n+    if not spec.tools:\r\n+        graph.add_edge(\"agent\", END)\r\n+        return graph.compile()\r\n+\r\n+    def calls(messages):\r\n+        return [call[\"name\"] for m in messages for call in (getattr(m, \"tool_calls\", None) or [])]\r\n+\r\n+    def rounds(messages) -> int:\r\n+        return sum(1 for m in messages if getattr(m, \"tool_calls\", None))\r\n+\r\n+    def more_or_wrap_up(state) -> str:\r\n+        return \"wrap_up\" if rounds(state[\"messages\"]) >= max_tool_rounds else \"agent\"\r\n+\r\n+    def wrap_up(state):\r\n+        repeated = \", \".join(f\"{name} x{n}\" for name, n in Counter(calls(state[\"messages\"])).most_common())\r\n+        logger.warning(\"%s used its %d tool rounds (%s); asking for its report\",\r\n+                       spec.agent_node, max_tool_rounds, repeated)\r\n+        return agent({**state, \"messages\": [*state[\"messages\"], HumanMessage(WRAP_UP)]})\r\n+\r\n+    graph.add_node(\"tools\", ToolNode(list(spec.tools)))\r\n+    graph.add_node(\"wrap_up\", wrap_up)\r\n+    graph.add_conditional_edges(\"agent\", _tools_or_done, [\"tools\", END])\r\n+    graph.add_conditional_edges(\"tools\", more_or_wrap_up, [\"agent\", \"wrap_up\"])\r\n+    graph.add_edge(\"wrap_up\", END)\r\n+    return graph.compile()\r\n+\r\n+\r\n+class GraphSetup:\r\n+    \"\"\"Handles the setup and configuration of the agent graph.\"\"\"\r\n+\r\n+    def __init__(\r\n+        self,\r\n+        quick_thinking_llm: Any,\r\n+        deep_thinking_llm: Any,\r\n+        conditional_logic: ConditionalLogic,\r\n+        max_tool_rounds: int,\r\n+    ):\r\n+        \"\"\"Initialize with required components.\"\"\"\r\n+        self.quick_thinking_llm = quick_thinking_llm\r\n+        self.deep_thinking_llm = deep_thinking_llm\r\n+        self.conditional_logic = conditional_logic\r\n+        self.max_tool_rounds = max_tool_rounds\r\n+\r\n+    def setup_graph(\r\n+        self,\r\n+        selected_analysts=(\"market\", \"social\", \"news\", \"fundamentals\", \"options\"),\r\n+        memory_node=None,\r\n+    ):\r\n+        \"\"\"Set up and compile the agent workflow graph.\r\n+\r\n+        Args:\r\n+            selected_analysts (list): List of analyst types to include. Options are:\r\n+                - \"market\": Market analyst\r\n+                - \"social\": Sentiment analyst\r\n+                - \"news\": News analyst\r\n+                - \"fundamentals\": Fundamentals analyst\r\n+                - \"options\": Options analyst\r\n+            memory_node: Node that settles past decisions and returns the run's\r\n+                ``past_context``. It runs alongside the analysts.\r\n+        \"\"\"\r\n+        plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analysts)\r\n+\r\n+        analyst_factories = {\r\n+            \"market\": lambda: create_market_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),\r\n+            \"social\": lambda: create_sentiment_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),\r\n+            \"news\": lambda: create_news_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),\r\n+            \"fundamentals\": lambda: create_fundamentals_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),\r\n+            \"options\": lambda: create_options_analyst(self.quick_thinking_llm),\r\n+        }\r\n+\r\n+        bull_researcher_node = create_bull_researcher(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+        # FEAT-02: the bear node owns the once-per-pair progress judgement; it\r\n+        # reuses the same quick-tier LLM (no new client or provider).\r\n+        bear_researcher_node = create_bear_researcher(\r\n+            self.quick_thinking_llm, judge=build_debate_judge(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+        )\r\n+        research_manager_node = create_research_manager(self.deep_thinking_llm)\r\n+        trader_node = create_trader(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+\r\n+        aggressive_analyst = create_aggressive_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+        neutral_analyst = create_neutral_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+        conservative_analyst = create_conservative_debator(self.quick_thinking_llm)\r\n+        portfolio_manager_node = create_portfolio_manager(self.deep_thinking_llm)\r\n+\r\n+        workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)\r\n+\r\n+        for spec in plan.specs:\r\n+            workflow.add_node(spec.agent_node,\r\n+                              _analyst_graph(spec, analyst_factories[spec.key](), self.max_tool_rounds))\r\n+\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Bull Researcher\", bull_researcher_node)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Bear Researcher\", bear_researcher_node)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Research Manager\", research_manager_node)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Trader\", trader_node)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Aggressive Analyst\", aggressive_analyst)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Neutral Analyst\", neutral_analyst)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Conservative Analyst\", conservative_analyst)\r\n+        workflow.add_node(\"Portfolio Manager\", portfolio_manager_node)\r\n+\r\n+        # The analysts work at the same time; the research debate starts once\r\n+        # every one of them has filed its report. The memory log settles past\r\n+        # decisions alongside them: only the Portfolio Manager reads its lessons.\r\n+        first_steps = [spec.agent_node for spec in plan.specs]\r\n+        if memory_node is not None:\r\n+            workflow.add_node(\"Memory Log\", memory_node)\r\n+            first_steps.append(\"Memory Log\")\r\n+        for node in first_steps:\r\n+            workflow.add_edge(START, node)\r\n+        workflow.add_edge(first_steps, \"Bull Researcher\")\r\n+\r\n+        # Both research-debate edges share the complete DEBATE_PATH_MAP (#1088).\r\n+        for debate_node in (\"Bull Researcher\", \"Bear Researcher\"):\r\n+            workflow.add_conditional_edges(\r\n+                debate_node,\r\n+                self.conditional_logic.should_continue_debate,\r\n+                DEBATE_PATH_MAP,\r\n+            )\r\n+        workflow.add_edge(\"Research Manager\", \"Trader\")\r\n+        workflow.add_edge(\"Trader\", \"Aggressive Analyst\")\r\n+        # All three risk edges share the complete RISK_ANALYSIS_PATH_MAP (#1088).\r\n+        for risk_node in (\"Aggressive Analyst\", \"Conservative Analyst\", \"Neutral Analyst\"):\r\n+            workflow.add_conditional_edges(\r\n+                risk_node,\r\n+                self.conditional_logic.should_continue_risk_analysis,\r\n+                RISK_ANALYSIS_PATH_MAP,\r\n+            )\r\n+\r\n+        workflow.add_edge(\"Portfolio Manager\", END)\r\n+\r\n+        return workflow\r\n",

          "content": "\"\"\"FEAT-02 / FR-DEB-01: semantic progress judgement for the bull/bear debate.\n\nThis is a leaf module: it imports only ``pydantic`` and the shared structured\nhelper so that both ``graph`` (the router) and ``agents`` (the bear node) can\nimport it without a cycle. It never imports ``tradingagents.graph``.\n\nFR-DEB-01 says the debate ends early when neither side introduces evidence new\nto this debate nor gives a first substantive reply to a previously unanswered\nopposing argument. Surface heuristics (new numbers, entities, reply markers) are\nnot faithful to that meaning, so a structured semantic judgement decides it.\nThe judgement is computed once per eligible completed pair, in the bear node.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom tradingagents.agents.structured import NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nPROGRESS = \"PROGRESS\"\nNO_PROGRESS = \"NO_PROGRESS\"\nUNKNOWN = \"UNKNOWN\"\n\n# The exact approved early-stop reason (FR-DEB-01 / FEAT-02 blueprint).\nEARLY_STOP_REASON = \"No new evidence or first response in this round\"\n\n_CONFIDENCE_RANK = {\"low\": 0, \"medium\": 1, \"high\": 2}\n\n\nclass _SideJudgement(BaseModel):\n    new_evidence: bool = Field(\n        description=\"True if this turn introduces a fact/observation not already \"\n        \"present in the prior debate         "input": {
          "content": "\"\"\"Guarded single-request probe of the DebateJudge against the CityU DeepSeek endpoint.\n\nThis is a live, network-calling test and is excluded from the default offline\nsuite (``integration`` marker, and it also requires an explicit opt-in). It makes\nEXACTLY ONE structured-output request through the real\n``tradingagents.agents.debate_progress.DebateJudge.evaluate`` path, on a known\ndebate example. It never runs the seven-case semantic evaluation.\n\nEnable and run it only when you have authorised the call:\n\n    # PowerShell (values are read from the environment; never printed)\n    $env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY = \"<your CityU token>\"      # your token, not shown here\n    $env:TRADINGAGENTS_CITYU_PROBE = \"1\"\n    $env:TRADINGAGENTS_CITYU_BASE_URL = \"https://llm.cs.cityu.edu.hk/v1\"  # optional\n    & .\\\\.venv\\\\Scripts\\\\python.exe -m pytest `\n        test/live/test_debate_judge_cityu_probe.py -m integration -q -s\n\nNothing here prints the API key or the base URL's credentials. On any outcome the\ntest prints a single, secret-free diagnostic line and asserts the selected\nclassification.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nimport pytest\n\nCITYU_BASE_URL_DEFAULT = \"https://llm.cs.cityu.edu.hk/v1\"\nCITYU_MODEL = \"CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash\"\n\n# A known debate example: the bear restates a point already made and answered, so\n# a correct judge should NOT mark it as new evidence or a first reply. The probe\n# only checks that the call succeeded and returned a parsed DebateJudgement; it\n# is not a semantic-accuracy assertion.\nHISTORY = (\n    \"Bull Analyst: Demand is not cyclical because backlog is multi-year.\\n\"\n    \"Bear Analyst: To address your backlog point, the backlog can be cancelled.\"\n)\nBULL_TURN = \"Bull Analyst: Regarding your demand point, demand is not cyclical because backlog is multi-year.\"\nBEAR_TURN = \"Bear Analyst: To address your backlog point, the backlog can be cancelled.\"\n\n\ndef _probe_enabled() -> bool:\n    return os.environ.get(\"TRADINGAGENTS_CITYU_PROBE\") == \"1\"\n\n\ndef _has_real_key() -> bool:\n    key = os.environ.get(\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY\", \"\")\n    return bool(key) and key != \"placeholder\"\n\n\npytestmark = [\n    pytest.mark.integration,\n    pytest.mark.skipif(not _probe_enabled(),\n                       reason=\"set TRADINGAGENTS_CITYU_PROBE=1 to authorise the one live call\"),\n    pytest.mark.skipif(not _has_real_key(),\n                       reason=\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY not set (or placeholder); skipping live probe\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _build_judge():\n    \"\"\"Real deepseek client at the CityU endpoint with bounded retries/timeout.\"\"\"\n    from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import build_debate_judge\n    from tradingagents.llm_clients import create_llm_client\n\n    base_url = os.environ.get(\"TRADINGAGENTS_CITYU_BASE_URL\", CITYU_BASE_URL_DEFAULT)\n    client = create_llm_client(\n        provider=\"deepseek\",\n        model=CITYU_MODEL,\n        base_url=base_url,\n        max_retries=0,   # exactly one HTTP attempt\n        timeout=60,      # seconds; no unbounded hang\n    )\n    return build_debate_judge(client.get_llm())\n\n\ndef _classify_exception(exc: Exception) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Map a failure to a coarse, secret-free category.\"\"\"\n    name = type(exc).__name__\n    text = str(exc).lower()\n    if \"429\" in text or \"rate limit\" in text or \"too many requests\" in text:\n        return \"rate_limit\"\n    if any(t in text for t in (\"401\", \"403\", \"unauthorized\", \"invalid api key\",\n                               \"authentication\", \"permission\")):\n        return \"auth_failure\"\n    if any(t in text for t in (\"response_format\", \"json_schema\", \"tool_choice\",\n                               \"structured\", \"not supported\", \"400\")):\n        return \"unsupported_structured_output\"\n    if any(t in text for t in (\"timeout\", \"timed out\", \"connection\")):\n        return \"network_or_timeout\"\n    return f\"other:{name}\"\n\n\ndef test_cityu_single_structured_probe(capsys):\n    \"\"\"One structured call through DebateJudge.evaluate(); classify the outcome.\"\"\"\n    from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import _render_prompt\n\n    judge = _build_judge()\n    prompt = _render_prompt(HISTORY, BULL_TURN, BEAR_TURN)\n\n    # Exactly one network request, via the real evaluate() path.\n    try:\n        judgement = judge.evaluate(prompt)\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — classify, never re-raise secrets\n        category = _classify_exception(exc)\n        diagnostic = {\n            \"provider\": \"deepseek\",\n            \"model\": CITYU_MODEL,\n            \"outcome\": category,\n            \"exception_type\": type(exc).__name__,\n            \"message_head\": str(exc)[:200],\n        }\n        with capsys.disabled():\n            print(\"\\nCITYU_PROBE \" + json.dumps(diagnostic, ensure_ascii=True))\n        pytest.fail(f\"probe outcome={category}; see CITYU_PROBE diagnostic above\")\n\n    if judgement is None:\n        diagnostic = {\n            \"provider\": \"deepseek\",\n            \"model\": CITYU_MODEL,\n            \"outcome\": \"unsupported_structured_output\",\n            \"detail\": \"evaluate() returned None (no structured binding or unparseable)\",\n        }\n        with capsys.disabled():\n            print(\"\\nCITYU_PROBE \" + json.dumps(diagnostic, ensure_ascii=True))\n        pytest.fail(\"probe outcome=unsupported_structured_output (evaluate returned None)\")\n\n    # Parsed successfully: report only safe, non-secret fields.\n    diagnostic = {\n        \"provider\": \"deepseek\",\n        \"model\": CITYU_MODEL,\n        \"outcome\": \"success\",\n        \"bull\": judgement.bull.model_dump(),\n        \"bear\": judgement.bear.model_dump(),\n        \"stated_outcome\": judgement.outcome,\n    }\n    with capsys.disabled():\n        print(\"\\nCITYU_PROBE \" + json.dumps(diagnostic, ensure_ascii=True))\n\n    # The probe validates shape, not semantic correctness of the label.\n    assert judgement.bull is not None and judgement.bear is not None\n    assert judgement.outcome in {\"PROGRESS\", \"NO_PROGRESS\", \"UNKNOWN\"}\n",
          "filePath": "E:\\CityU课程材料\\CS5351软工\\CS5351-Project\\TradingAgents\\test\\live\\test_debate_judge_cityu_probe.py"

SEM-05a stays a confirmed no-progress case on both sides.\n     sem_05a = next(c for c in cases if c[\"id\"] == \"SEM-05a\")\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_bull\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_bear\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_outcome\"] == \"NO_PROGRESS\"\n \n \n def _judge_judgement(judge, history, bull_turn, bear_turn):\n     \"\"\"Run the real judge's structured path for one pair; return the model or None.\n \n     Uses the public ``DebateJudge.evaluate`` accessor, which shares the structured\n     binding with ``invoke``. _render_prompt\n \n     prompt = _render_prompt(history, bull_turn, bear_turn)\n     return judge.evaluate(prompt)\n \n \n def _score_side(judgement, side):\n     \"\"\"The (new_evidence, first_reply) pair for one side of a DebateJudgement.\"\"\"\n     side_obj = getattr(judgement, side)\n     return {\"new_evidence\": side_obj.new_evidence, \"first_reply\": side_obj.first_reply}\n \n \n def _score_cases(judge, cases):\n     \"\"\"Score a judge against the labelled cases; return a list of mismatches.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import classify_judgement\n \n     failures = []\n     for case in cases:\n         if case[\"archetype\"] == \"same-text-different-history\":\n             judgement = _judge_judgement(\n                 judge, case[\"history_a\"],            got = _score_side(judgement, \"bull\")\n             if got != case[\"expect_in_history_a\"]:\n                 failures.append((case[\"id\"], \"A\", got, case[\"expect_in_history_a\"]))\n  failures.append((case[\"id\"], \"judge\", \"no structured judgement\", None))\n             continue\n         for side in (\"bull\", \"bear\"):\n             exp = case[f\"expect_{side}\"]\n def with_structured_output(self, schema, **kwargs):\n         class _Runner:\n             def __init__(self, fn):\n                 self._fn = fn\n \n             def invoke(self, prompt):\n Five mismatches were reported:\r\n+\r\n+| Case / side | Got | Expected |\r\n+| --- | --- | --- |\r\n+| SEM-01 bear | `{new_evidence: false, first_reply: false}` | `{new_evidence: true, first_reply: false}` |\r\n+| SEM-02 bear | `{new_evidence: true, first_reply: true}` | `{new_evidence: true, first_reply: false}` |\r\n+| SEM-04 bull | `{new_evidence: true, first_reply: true}` | `{new_evidence: false, first_reply: true}` |\r\n+| SEM-04 bear | `{new_evidence: true, first_reply: true}` | `{new_evidence: false, first_reply: true}` |\r\n+| SEM-06 history A | `{new_evidence: false, first_reply: false}` | `{new_evidence: false, first_reply: true}` |\r\n+\r\n+Analysis: these were **fixture/evaluation-design defects, not established model errors**. The captured run output is `transcripts/FEAT-02-live-eval-2026-11-22.txt`. SEM-04's original text introduced new facts (fixed contracts; contracts expiring) though it was labelled `new_evidence:false`; SEM-01's bear reused the bull's same-pair margin fact; SEM-02's bear directly rebutted the bull's current point (a defensible first reply); SEM-06's history A already contained the very reply under judgement and history B was never scored. The fixtures were corrected (SEM-01 bear → an independent new fact; SEM-02 bear → independent evidence, no same-pair rebuttal; SEM-04 → text that reuses only history facts; SEM-06 → history A before the reply, history B after it, both scored with the same reply text; approved labels A `{new:true, first_reply:true}`, B `{new:false, first_reply:false}`). The live evaluation has **not** been re-run since the corrections; real semantic accuracy remains unverified. the facts and rebuttals are repeats.\"\n     },\n     {\n       \"id\": \"SEM-04\",\n       \"archetype\": \"first-reply-without-marker\",\n-      \"history\": \"Bull Analyst: Margins are expanding.\\nBear Analyst: Rising input costs will compress margins.\",\n-      \"bull_turn\": \"Bull Analyst: Input-cost contracts are fixed through next year, so the compression the bear expects will not occur.\",\n-      \"bear_turn\": \"Bear Analyst: Fixed contracts expire, leaving exposure after year end.\",\n+      \"history\": \"Bull Analyst: Margins are expanding while input costs are rising.\\nBear Analyst: Rising input costs will compress those margins.\",\n+      \"bull_turn\": \"Bull Analyst: You say rising input costs will compress margins, but margins have been expanding while input costs are rising, so the compression you expect has not occurred.\",\n+      \"bear_turn\": \"Bear Analyst: You say margins have been expanding despite rising input costs, yet rising input costs have not stopped threatening those margins.\",\n       \"expect_bull\": {\"new_evidence\": false, \"first_reply\": true},\n       \"expect_bear\": {\"new_evidence\": false, \"first_reply\": true},\n       \"expect_outcome\": \"PROGRESS\",\n-      \"rationale\": \"The bull's turn is a first substantive reply to the bear's unanswered margin-compression point, with no explicit reply marker;           "patch": "Index: test/offline/test_debate_semantics_eval.py\n===================================================================\n--- test/offline/test_debate_semantics_eval.py\t\n+++ test/offline/test_debate_semantics_eval.py\t\n@@ -1,375 +1,414 @@\n \"\"\"FR-DEB-01: semantic evaluation of the debate-progress judge.\n \n This is deliberately separate from ``test_debate_early_stop.py``:\n \n - ``test_debate_early_stop.py`` scripts the judge's *outcome* to test routing,\n   state flow, handoff and persistence (\"plumbing\"). Mocks there prove the\n   pipeline acts on a result; they say nothing about whether the judge is right.\n - This module evaluates the *judge itself* against a fixed, labelled set of\n   semantic cases (``debate_progress_eval/cases.json``).\n \n The labels are PROPOSED by the coding agent and await human review; they are not\n human-approved yet.\n \n A real-judge run needs a live structured model call, so it is excluded from the\n default offline suite with the ``integration`` marker and only runs when\n ``DEBATE_EVAL_LIVE=1`` is set and a judge is available. The default (offline) path\n only validates the fixture and the judge contract, so CI stays hermetic and no\n TradingAgents model call is made in this stage.\n \n The opt-in uses ``DEBATE_EVAL_LIVE`` (not a ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` name) on purpose:\n ``test/conftest.py`` blanks every ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` variable at import time, so\n an opt-in under that prefix would always read as unset (the same reason the CityU\n probe uses ``CITYU_PROBE``).\n \n Pass criteria for a live run (documented, applied when opted in):\n - Build the judge through the same leaf contract the bear node uses.\n - For every case: the judge's ``new_evidence`` and ``first_reply`` flags must\n   match the expected flags for BOTH sides, and the resulting outcome must match.\n - SEM-06 is scored per history (A and B) against its two expectations.\n - Acceptance: 100% of the six archetypes correct (exact match). Near-miss\n   variants, if added later, are reported as precision/recall and are advisory.\n \n Requirement: FR-DEB-01. Entry point for the live check (CityU DeepSeek endpoint):\n     DEBATE_EVAL_LIVE=1 python -m pytest \\\\\n         test/offline/test_debate_semantics_eval.py -m integration -q\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import json\n import os\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import pytest\n \n CASES_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / \"debate_progress_eval\" / \"cases.json\"\n \n REQUIRED_ARRAYS = {\"cases\"}\n \n # CityU DeepSeek endpoint used for the live run (same as the guarded probe). The\n # client is built directly so no TRADINGAGENTS_* provider config is required.\n CITYU_BASE_URL_DEFAULT = \"https://llm.cs.cityu.edu.hk/v1\"\n CITYU_MODEL = \"CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash\"\n \n \n def _load_cases():\n     data = json.loads(CASES_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n     return data\n \n \n def test_fixture_is_well_formed():\n     \"\"\"Offline: the labelled set parses and every case carries its labels.\"\"\"\n     data = _load_cases()\n     assert set(data) >= REQUIRED_ARRAYS\n     cases = data[\"cases\"]\n     assert len(cases) == 7, \"six archetypes, with the marker/repeat case split in two\"\n \n     archetypes = {c[\"archetype\"] for c in cases}\n     assert archetypes == {\n         \"reused-number-new-fact\",\n         \"qualitative-fact-no-unit\",\n         \"relabelled-repetition\",\n         \"first-reply-without-marker\",\n         \"marker-repeats-already-answered-rebuttal\",\n         \"marker-repeat-but-other-side-first-reply\",\n         \"same-text-different-history\",\n     }\n \n     for case in cases:\n         assert case[\"id\"].startswith(\"SEM-\")\n         if case[\"archetype\"] == \"same-text-different-history\":\n             assert \"expect_in_history_a\" in case and \"expect_in_history_b\" in case\n             assert \"reply_text\" in case\n         else:\n             for side in (\"expect_bull\", \"expect_bear\"):\n                 flags = case[side]\n                 assert set(flags) == {\"new_evidence\", \"first_reply\"}\n                 assert all(isinstance(v, bool) for v in flags.values())\n             assert case[\"expect_outcome\"] in {\"PROGRESS\", \"NO_PROGRESS\"}\n \n     # SEM-05b must isolate the first-reply condition: the bear gives a first\n     # substantive reply using already-known facts, so no new evidence is claimed.\n     sem_05b = next(c for c in cases if c[\"id\"] == \"SEM-05b\")\n     assert sem_05b[\"expect_bear\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": True}\n     assert sem_05b[\"expect_bull\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n     assert sem_05b[\"expect_outcome\"] == \"PROGRESS\"\n \n     # SEM-05a stays a confirmed no-progress case on both sides.\n     sem_05a = next(c for c in cases if c[\"id\"] == \"SEM-05a\")\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_bull\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_bear\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n     assert sem_05a[\"expect_outcome\"] == \"NO_PROGRESS\"\n \n+    # SEM-06 is history-relative: A is before the reply, B after it, same text.\n+    sem_06 = next(c for c in cases if c[\"id\"] == \"SEM-06\")\n+    assert sem_06[\"history_a\"] not in (None, \"\")\n+    assert sem_06[\"history_b\"] not in (None, \"\")\n+    assert sem_06[\"reply_text\"] not in (None, \"\")\n+    # The reply the thing under judgement must not already appear in history A,\n+    # otherwise \"is this a first reply?\" is ill-posed.\n+    assert sem_06[\"reply_text\"] not in sem_06[\"history_a\"]\n+    # B already contains the delivered reply.\n+    assert sem_06[\"reply_text\"] in sem_06[\"history_b\"]\n+    # Approved labels: A = new fact + first reply; B = repeat + no first reply.\n+    assert sem_06[\"expect_in_history_a\"] == {\"new_evidence\": True, \"first_reply\": True}\n+    assert sem_06[\"expect_in_history_b\"] == {\"new_evidence\": False, \"first_reply\": False}\n \n+\n def _judge_judgement(judge, history, bull_turn, bear_turn):\n     \"\"\"Run the real judge's structured path for one pair; return the model or None.\n \n     Uses the public ``DebateJudge.evaluate`` accessor, which shares the structured\n     binding with ``invoke``. Returns None when the judge cannot produce a parsed\n     ``DebateJudgement`` (the same structural-failure condition as ``invoke``).\n     \"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import _render_prompt\n \n     prompt = _render_prompt(history, bull_turn, bear_turn)\n     return judge.evaluate(prompt)\n \n \n def _score_side(judgement, side):\n     \"\"\"The (new_evidence, first_reply) pair for one side of a DebateJudgement.\"\"\"\n     side_obj = getattr(judgement, side)\n     return {\"new_evidence\": side_obj.new_evidence, \"first_reply\": side_obj.first_reply}\n \n \n def _score_cases(judge, cases):\n     \"\"\"Score a judge against the labelled cases; return a list of mismatches.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.agents.debate_progress import classify_judgement\n \n     failures = []\n     for case in cases:\n         if case[\"archetype\"] == \"same-text-different-history\":\n-            judgement = _judge_judgement(\n-                judge, case[\"history_a\"], case[\"reply_text\"], \"\"\n-            )\n-            if judgement is None:\n-                failures.append((case[\"id\"], \"A\", \"no structured judgement\", None))\n-                continue\n-            got = _score_side(judgement, \"bull\")\n-            if got != case[\"expect_in_history_a\"]:\n-                failures.append((case[\"id\"], \"A\", got, case[\"expect_in_history_a\"]))\n+            # Score the SAME current reply text against both histories: A is the\n+            # state before the reply, B is after it. case[history_key], case[\"reply_text\"], \"\"\n+                )\n+                if judgement is None:\n+                    failures.append((case[\"id\"], label, \"no structured judgement\",
